reviews.text: Fantastic experience with Valet Vet! Great option for those of us whom have a pet that does not do well in car trips. Dr. Carrie and Alicia were so kind, insightful, and attentive to my pal Book!   Book and I fully endorse their services and will definitely use them again. Thank you Valet Vet, see you soon.
Valley vet staff and Dr Chelsi are the best. It was so much more less stressful for Livi. They were gentle and patient with her. She is getting better every day. Thank you!

The vets came to my home to do blood work for my sick cat, which spared her a stressful trip to the clinic. They were gentle, patient, and thorough, and took the time to explain what they were doing and answer our questions. Having this care available at home made a difficult situation much easier. We’re grateful for their kindness and would highly recommend them.
I highly recommend valet vet. Not only is it convenient but the lady's were very knowledgeable and accommodating! Will certainly be using them from now on
Prompt replies, easy to set up care, amazing Vet and Vet tech. My fur baby loved them!
My little girl was put down by your service and it was the least stressful as possible. Thanks for helping me through this.  Miss her but at least I know she didn’t suffer. Thank you

Very much a recommendation to those of you who have fearful dogs, especially large(or XL) Breeds. I work in vet med as well, but I didnt want to make my fearful mastiffs anxiety worse and have it be a negative connotation, so I decided to have a mobile vet come to my house to do his wellness vaccines. They went at Yngwie's pace, and were absolutely exceptional with him. Their pricing is fair, and the staff that I have interacted with have all been exteremely pleasant and prompt when answering my questions or getting back to me about estimates. Yngwie and I appreciate Valet Vet, and recommend them for those of you who have neophobic dogs!

My experience with Valet Vet was fantastic! My best friend in the whole wide world and love of my life, my dog Book was just treated by Dr. Carrie and Alicia. They were phenomenal. Big thank you to them. They made the experience enjoyable. Book doesn't do well in car rides nor does he socialize well with other dogs, so Valet Vet is a dream option for us. They bring the Vet office to your living room. No stress on Book nor me to endure. Dr. Carrie and Alicia were so caring and gentle, that Book didn't even notice when they gave him an shot in his rear end. I recommend highly and I will definitely use there services from here on out. Thank you so much Dr. Carrie, Alicia, and Valet Vet see you soon 🙏🏼🤓🐶

AWESOME!!!  Can’t say enough good things about Valet Vet! Top notch.
Thanks so much
Jeff Griffin

I am not able to drive so can't take my pup out to a vet.  Valet Vet provides the service in my home.  I trust them with their care for my pup.  I know a mobile vet tends to be more expensive but both my pup and they are worth it.

We thank our lucky stars that Valet Vet exists. We just wish more vets were moving in the direction of at-home vet services. We have three cats, none of which are good patients. We try desperately to keep their lives stress free but as a lot of us know and understand, cats are delicate creatures who don’t handle the stress of traveling to vets very well. Instead, having your kitties’ health checked up in the familiarity of your home is so much healthier for the kitties. They even offer mobile ultrasound. Some of the more difficult procedures happen in the mobile unit while most other procedures happen inside your home. We have really liked everyone who has helped us in the past. So far they’ve done a wonderful job keeping our cats healthy and happy. Thank you Valet Vet!

Just recently, I had to have Romie go home to her Papa, my husband after nearly 17yrs and  2 kind and beautiful Angel ladies made the transition to Heaven with such grace and peace for Romie so peaceful .. 😌 I know Danny was saying come her baby girl💔🥰
Please call them when it’s time for your fur baby to go home

Valet Vet was great, professional, and caring for my sweet girl Nola (rescued German Shepherd) during dental surgery, general care, up and through pain management for hip dysplasia and osteoarthritis. They were compassionate in helping me determine when it was time to put her out of her suffering. (One of the hardest decisions of my life).
I would recommend them highly for any of your pets needs, especially if vet visits are causing anxiety. They are great with timid and/or anxious pets!
Top notch every time, will always use
Dr. Chelsi and her assistant were simply the best. Very compassionate and caring. I would definitely use their services.
Dr Chelsi and Armelin were so fantastic with my 7 year old husky! We haven’t been able to get her some help due to stress and coming to her was perfect!

I had a great first experience using valet vet for my very anxious cat. Everyone I interacted with was extremely kind and accommodating. I moved recently and the apartment required updated vaccinations, which would be nearly impossible to get for her if I had to take her to a traditional vet. By the time we would usually do a car ride and the waiting room, my cat would already be overwhelmed and not let anyone touch her. Dr. Chelsi was very sweet and patient with her and I appreciated how they took time to make my cat as comfortable as possible. I would definitely recommend valet vet to anyone seeking at-home veterinary care.

We had the loss of our Jack. He was 18 1/2 years old he also was a rescue at the age of 4. The vet and technicians were the best. Jack has 4 brothers and 4 sisters they were able to be right there with Jack as he passed. I have had the best experience in a tough time. Thanks for all your help. He is back home with us. Thank you!!! The Ruff house.

Valet Bet has been wonderful in dealing with all of my pets needs. Recently, I had to put down my Maximillian,Maxi, cat who was 18 years old. The care that they showed, and the easiness of his transfer over the Rainbow Bridge was amazing. My other cat laid right by him, and my two French Mastiffs by me. It was peaceful for Max and all of us. I greatly appreciate their consideration and support.

We highly recommend Valet Pet. They were very professional and caring for our pet who has hip dysplasia. Our pet is very skittish and gets very scared going to a regular vet office, so their mobile service is a great way to avoid that type of situation with our sweet girl. Thanks for a great customer experience Valet Vet!
Very professional, thorough and caring
The doctors with VV are great. Caring and thorough. I feel Hailey is getting good care!
Staff was on time to my house, friendly and answered all my questions. Highly recommend for dogs with social/anxiety issues...very stress-free experience!
It was such a good experience to have the Vet and his Assistant come to my apartment to meet my fur-baby. They took samples from his lump and texted me 3 days later to say all was fine.
The veterinarians were amazing, gentle, and patient with my dog who suffers with anxiety. The home visit worked perfectly for our dog thank you.

I’ve been using Valet Vet for many years, and I couldn’t be happier with the care. The veterinarians and staff are always professional, knowledgeable, and compassionate. Everyone is personable, friendly, and genuinely cares about both the animals and their owners. It. I highly recommend for home service.

We have been using Valet Vet since 2017 they are very thorough, fees are less then taking your pet to a vet clinic. There app is very easy to use to schedule appointments. They did so well with my Yetti the other day he has had chronic ear infections for the past year we have taken him to different vets 3 times and no relief. He is finally feeling some relief. ❤️
Dr. Carrie is exceptional - knowledgeable, patient, and caring. Her team is highly skilled and supportive. Valet Vet has been a true blessing!!
Kind and knowledgeable. So glad we didn’t have to traumatize our cat by taking her to the vet. Highly recommend if you have a nervous kitty.

Thank You! For coming to our home and seeing our beloved great pyrenees who was very sick.
While Lovett, the initial vet, continued to tell me for months that my beautiful boy just had a cough or upper respiratory infection, then proceeded to give him a
STOMACH XRAY!
Dr Hiller & her assistant were compassionate and were out quickly. Dr. Hiller only had to examine him to know it wasn't just an upper respiratory infection and noted he didn't have a fever. Gave our boy some meds to feel better and even saved us money on the prescriptions. Told us to immediately get him in for imaging, as she suspected a throat issue! Possibly Lar-Par (Larynx Paralysis)
Why hasn't Lovett been as thorough or knowledgeable? My boy went in to get sedated and have a scope search of his throat! While they were preparing to put the tube in his throat, they quit and packed it up! Very Sadly, my boy had a sizeable throat tumor with no chance at survival. They couldn't have even gotten a tube down his throat!
We were referred to consult several veterinary surgeons, and we consulted them all! They all concur! Lovett, the initial vet, missed it in January when symptoms first started and continued to test for valley fever, kennel cough, all negative, and told us his drooling was gingivitis. A simple hands on exam was all Valet Vet & Dr.Hiller needed to do to know it was something very serious! My boy was put at peace yesterday and he can go run, eat, and bark again with no more pain!
It's killing me! But this is our selfless way of taking their pain and setting them free! My boy lived nine beautiful, spoiled years! His final days, He ate McDonald's! Mexican Food! Italian Food! Ice cream! Tuna! Macaroni! Chicken! Sausage! Pancakes with syrup and butter! And was so happy and then let us know, he was ready to go!
We love you so much, Sydney!
Thank you, Valet Vet, wonderful Dr. Hiller and her sweet assistant for ALL your Help! We had NO idea!
Thank You! As you helped put him at peace and he's no longer in pain.
We had NO idea! Thank you!
Wonderful people to work with in the care of my senior dog.

It's so much less stressful for our dogs - no waiting in a scary place, no other pets crying out in pain or fear, and it's all over very quickly! They're kind, gentle, and knowledgeable, and do what they can to reduce our dogs' stress or discomfort as much as possible.

We had them come to our house.  We were very impressed with how they handled our cat.  They definitely knew what they were doing and we will definitely schedule them again when it comes time for our cats updates on his shots

We absolutely love having a mobile vet. The convenience alone is incredible, but what really stands out is the level of care and attention we receive every single visit. Our pets are so much more relaxed being seen in their own home instead of being stressed in a clinic waiting room, and honestly it makes the entire experience more comfortable for everyone involved.

The vets take the time to truly listen, observe, and interact with the animals in their normal environment. They’ll sit on the floor with them, move at the pet’s pace, and you can genuinely tell they care about the animal and not just rushing through appointments. We’ve never felt pressured into unnecessary tests or treatments, which has unfortunately been our experience at some traditional vet offices.

The care feels thoughtful, personal, and compassionate. We’re so grateful to have found a veterinary team we trust this much and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a less stressful, more caring experience for their pets.

Today we had to make the tough decision to put our beloved 13 year old dog to sleep, and I’d just like to say thank you to the wonderful people at Valet Vet for all of their care and support. From the initial phone call to their office, to the two vet techs that came to our home, everyone was compassionate and very kind. It was a hard day for my family but the entire staff with Valet Vet helped us get through it and we appreciate it so much. Our dog was a member of our family and she was able to pass on surrounded by her people and in her own home thanks to the services offered by Valet Vet.

Dr. Chelsi & Savannah were fantastic. They managed to make our senior dog comfortable enough to do an exam. It was great having them in our home so they could see our dog in her own environment. We'll schedule all future appointments with them. 11/10
Very professional, they helped us out with our fur baby, very caring and knowledgeable and answered our questions and concerns.
They were very pleasant and great with both dogs. Will definitely use again
EVERYONE WHO CAME WAS SO KIND TO MY CAT AND HELPFUL
Very knowledgeable and caring service. They know how to put even the most timid pup at ease and approach him with a soft touch.
They are understanding of the dog's hesitation and do not bully it
Best way to go if you have an anxious pet.

Compassionate care and gentle care. I've been a customer for three years and they still continue to impress me. They've assisted two of my fur babies cross the Rainbow Bridge, and did it with the utmost care and love. I highly recommend their services.
Great vet, my dogs loved them, if you need a vet to come to your house I highly recommend them
Now that I can't get around so well, these folks are a God send! Worth every penny - 2 fur friends have had to cross with their help and one guy was just visited yesterday. Great folks!

Callous, rigid and unhelpful. Scheduled an appointment online to be in less than 2 days. They emailed the next morning claiming I was outside their service area, but I had checked and made sure I was within a 20 mile drive. I called them to point out the issue, and they claimed there's an undisclosed caveat that they don't go below I-10. I'm literally 1 street below the highway; it's the view in front of my house. I discussed how sick my dog was and asked for a very minor exception as I was having trouble finding one in my area or with a son enough appointment. They held completely steadfast and wouldn't budge! They gave me a short list of other options for the east valley--which I'm not even in--and 1 that didn't even do hospice care. Fortunately I was able to find another mobile vet eventually, who was awesome and more affordable to boot.

Our dog has severe anxiety so going to the vet has been very difficult. Valet Vet was able to get her calm enough to get services needed and get blood drawn which we haven’t been able to do in years. We will definitely be having them back out to our home.

This was my second visit from valet veterinarians, and they really came through for me again when my cat, Zen, started frequenting the litter box without a whole lot of urine coming out.  Having head cats my whole adult life as pets, I knew something was up.

They came over as soon as practically as possible, and methodically felt for his bladder to tell me it was small and so that the odds are of having a blockage was very little. Proactively, in case it was a UTI, they gave me some antibiotics and anti-inflammatories for his possible discomfort from the UTI.

Zen is doing much better.  I was well aware that male cats are more susceptible to urinary tract issues and they confirmed that as well, but we're confident enough that Zen and I were going to get through this no matter what the issue was. Thank you so much!

If you have difficult pets during transportation, I highly recommend Valet Veterinarians.  They're very knowledgeable and take great care to understand your concerns and your pet's comfort needs.

Vet Valet has been to my home three times in the past 14 months. Each time the technician and doctor were very accommodating, extremely kind with my pets, and very professional. One visit was to euthanize my dog. They were so very gentle and kind with my Lexi girl and myself while helping her to cross the rainbow bridge. I highly recommend Vet Valet.

I am so glad I chose them, my dog gets bad anxiety when at the vet. When they arrived they were so friendly, my dog thought they were visitors. He received his shots and was well taking care of. I highly recommend using them!

Valet Vet will be my go-to place for veterinarian care in the future.
Not only was my cat treated with care, but I was also treated with
respect and care. Thanks
Arrived on time.  Professional took care of my pets needs in a caring concise manner
Professional , prompt , kind and competent. Will Definitely use them from now on
The vets were very kind and compassionate. They didn’t charge a same day fee and offered advice on calming my cat. You can tell they care and are knowledgeable.

So grateful to have found Valet Vet. Our older cat had gone to an urgent care and still was only marginally better so we followed up her care with Valet Vet . We wanted to keep her in our home and not have to traumatize her further with another carrier and loud office visit. Valet vet communicated when they’d be here and obtained her records from the urgent care. The veterinarian and tech were caring and compassionate and recommended treatment options which were effective. Our girl is back! The experience of having a vet come to the home was so much less traumatic for our girl and well worth it to us. Pricing was very reasonable considering the at home visit. I recommend Valet Vet without hesitation.
I have had many different pets over the years with different vets, I am very happy to have had Dr. Finney visit us the other day.

Valet vet exceeded our expectations.  Dr Jennifer was wonderful with our dog Cache. She changed his meds and explained  in detail what we could expect from  his treatment.  She is a very caring vet and I would recommend  Valet Vet to anyone who needs home visits.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Dr. Kim and the entire team at Valet Vet provided truly exceptional care for my dogs, Max and Rolley. From start to finish, the experience was professional, compassionate, and incredibly convenient. Having veterinary care come right to our home made everything so much less stressful for my dogs, and the level of attention they received was outstanding.

Dr. Kim was patient, thorough, and took the time to explain everything clearly while making sure both Max and Rolley were comfortable and relaxed. It’s obvious how much she genuinely cares about animals, and that kindness shows in the way she interacts with both pets and their owners.

The staff was just as wonderful—friendly, organized, and extremely attentive. The entire process was smooth and efficient, and I truly appreciated how thoughtful and gentle everyone was with my dogs.

If you’re looking for veterinary care that is professional, compassionate, and incredibly convenient, I highly recommend Valet Vet and Dr. Kim. Max and Rolley received top-notch care, and I’m so grateful for the wonderful experience. 🐾

The first year I had them they were great, my anxious dog gets vicious and the next year they left yelling go train him. I called another vet and he prescribed another medication that worked so my pup was not hopeless.

Dr Carrie and Savanna are off the charts kind and knowledgeable. Thank you for the care you provided Grizzly.

Update:  three months in and need refills for flea and tick. Need to schedule an appointment but they are only available Tuesday’s and Thursday’s and no other days without an additional charge. Not very accommodating or helpful. Will not renew or use again. Texts were very impersonal and not service oriented. Very disappointing for the amount paid for care. Too expensive for level of service. If service was 5 star, no issue with price. Make sure you shop around. Many choices.

Valet Vet came to my home to provide checkups, vaccinations, and ear cleanings for my two cats. The two women who visited were extremely professional, respectful, and gentle with my cats. They clearly cared about my pets’ comfort and well-being. I had a great experience and would definitely recommend them.

I'm moving soon and needed to make sure my kitties vaccinations were up to date and they had sedatives for the trip. But I have so much to do with getting my house ready for sale, etc. It was super easy to schedule a visit with Valet Vet. The doctor and technician arrived on time (they texted me throughout the day so I knew when to expect them) and they were very gentle, yet thorough with my cats.  Both of my kitties are friendly, but don't like to be handled by strangers, however that was not a problem and now we are ready for the road.  Thank you Valet Vet!!

My dog weighs 230 pounds and loves to bark at new people and can be a little scary.She wouldn't hurt a flee  They are very professional and friendly. They love their patients. Thank you for caring for our big baby girl.
My large puppy accepted the assistance. All was well done. Thanks so much.

We have used Valet Vet for years. The services are so professional and the staff is friendly and caring toward our cats. They take the best care of our fur family, and have helped us navigate through elder care. Highly recommend.

Everyone is amazing. They have great communication and are so compassionate and patient. If you have a scared dog or cat, I highly recommend Valet Vet. Utilizing Valet Vet has been the most positive vet experience I have had in the Valley. A huge Thank You to the Valet Vet team!

Valet Vet was above and beyond when it came to euthanize my Bulldog. From the initial phone call to the in home care, the staff was incredibly caring, sincere and very kind during that rough day. After they called & sent a card - a very professional and great staff - a huge thank you for being so nice, Eric M

We have a 13 yr old, very large Bloodhound with hip trouble so getting him to the vet is a challenge. He has historically been incredibly anxious & aggressive at the vet too so we thought to try Valet Vet for his check up. Dr. Hiller & Savannah were amazing! He loved them (and the cat treats), was so calm & comfortable and he didn't even need a muzzle for a blood draw. I am ecstatic to have found a full service, affordable, in-home vet service with a fantastic staff.  They had the prescriptions he needed on hand & we got an appointment fast. This is a game changer.
Fantastic people. Caring and gentle with my 13 year old cat and lifelong family member. Prompt service and  great  communication.

My little 7lb, 12yr old baby Farris is a huge part of my emotional life. She is an apartment dump cat and the runt of the litter. My friend saved her and knew we belonged together. 12 yrs on I can’t imagine life without her. And she’s never been outside once she came home so having the Drs come to me is convenient. But more than that she is 80% more relaxed because we’re in her house and she can look right at me.

We are very happy with Dr. Carrie and Savannah from Valet Vets. We have a rescue dog who is afraid of going to the vet and getting her vaccines. Our previous vet told us she would need sedation. Having a mobile come to our home helped a lot. Dr. Carrie was very patient and Savannah helped distract her so she didn't need sedation. All my questions and concerns were answered.
Dr Carrie and Vet Tech were so great with Holly and Roscoe. Took the time to explain everything and were very gentle with both of my dogs. It was a wonderful experience.

I have a 12 YO rescue lab that has severe anxiety going to a physical vet, it used to be a major process requiring 2 adults to get her there safely.   She didn’t want to go, was fearful of being left there (we were her 5th home) and it was traumatic for all involved.  Honestly I cannot imagine not having this conservative, professional and compassionate service.  Highly recommend

We adopted a scared dog 3 years ago.  We are unable to get her to a vet's office so we have been using Valet Vet every year.  We have had several different vets and technicians at our house and they are all wonderful.  They make sure that they keep our pup as calm as possible.  This time we had Dr. Jennifer Sodetz and Vann and they actually cut her nails, something we thought would be impossible!  They are all so caring and so nice.  If your pet gets too anxious at the vet's office or if you are unable to get them there, I highly recommend any of their doctors and staff!

I received a booking confirmation by email for my pets appointment. They had recommended taking her to an urgent vet after confirming the day before I should wait and make an appointment if her symptoms continued. My pet improved so I made a normal appointment and mentioned multiple concerns and a second attempt to get a vaccine from this clinic. I received the confirmation that the job was booked. It appears this was untrue as I never received a follow up the day of and reached out to learn they never actually reserved the booking and the confirmation that the job was booked intended only as just a suggestion contradicting the prior days suggestion. Now, I have to find a new vet. I'm am so overwhelmingly disappointed in this service.

I would give Valet Vet a 10+ if I could!  If it’s hard to get your fur child to the vet, or if a trip to the vet stresses them, please know that there are alternatives!
My fur child and I highly recommend Valet Vet Mobile Veterinary Services!  Previously, even a routine visit to a traditional vet clinic was traumatizing, to say the least, for both of us. It would start by just walking in the door with the smells and sounds of the clinic, and continue to go downhill from there.
So, to find Valet Vet for in-home care was a definite blessing.  This is a 5-star, privately owned, women-led service.  Dr. Carrie and vet tech, Makenna, arrived at our home, sat down on the floor, and immediately began loving on my child.  Both were extremely kind and patient as they treated him, including immunizations, lab draws, etc., all in the comforts (and smells!) of his own environment. It was the best visit we have ever had, and we have definitely found our forever vet!  Your fur child will thank you!
Great service as always. The staff is very caring, efficient and thoughtful. We can't imagine using anyone else to care for our pet. Valet Vet is the best! We recommend them without hesitation.
The vets were great I just thought it was a lil expensive

I happen to have a very nervous Doberman mix who has never done well at the vet. We decided to give Valet Vet a try to see if she handles it better at home…they were amazing!! Took their time, helped her gain her confidence at her own pace. Dr. Carrie spoke to me about all of her options and I didn't feel pressured at all. So so grateful we found them!

Alicia and Dr. Kim were great. They were very patient with our high-anxiety dog and gave lots of pets to the others. They did a great job, were efficient with our time, and provided all the required certificates for the state.

Great experience, would use again.

Also, they aren't pushy about up-selling other products. Very refreshing.
We have used Valet Vet for years.   They are always great at communication, show up at the expected time and take great care of my dog when they are here.  I strongly recommend them.
Great service provided. We thank you for helping us with our Buddy.

Valet Vet was compassionate and kind when they arrived to our home to took at our senior pet. The appointment did not feel rushed and then vets did a great job with walking us through our dogs care. I’m happy to have them on the radar and will definitely call them again when we need care for our pets.
On tme, pet friendly and professional!! Will call on again for next visit.

I’ve only had this mobile vet for a couple years and I like them very well. My cat likes them and they listen to all my questions and they give me answers. This is a great veterinarian mobile first time having a mobile vet. Come to see me for the two years I think I started them when I first moved here. Maybe it’s only been a year both of the greatest company.

Dr. Kim & Makenna J., (Technician) were on time and provided care and trust in our Siberian Husky. Dr. Kim gave detailed information to my questions in writing which left no doubt as to what I needed to do. Using Valet Vet Mobile is a great convince to us because of the loose dog hair and my physical condition.
Very professional. Friendly. Absolutely great with my cat. Awesome bunch of ladies. I recommend them to all my friends.
Very nice and calm 11

After The Vets closed abruptly I was searching for a similar mobile Vet service and found Valet Vet. I’m so grateful that they were able to come out and meet our new puppy and begin his vaccinations as well as meet our other dogs and continue their care. They took the time needed with each pup. I’m confident that they will be caring for our fur babies for a very long time.
These people are wonderful. Great with our dog and with us as well. Super professional. We are repeat customers

I really like the staff and service from Valet Vet..I started utilizing their services when my Zeus went blind to avoid extra stress for him... continue to use them after Zeus' passing... compassionate and professional

Valet Vet comes to Phoenix Childrens hospital to do service on our full time facility dog, and they have always been on time, nice to deal with and very professional. They treat my working dog amazing, and very good at their job. Lisa

Valet Vet is kind, caring,compassionate , gentle....I cant say enough good things about them. My precious little boy (cat) was in pain. I called and they were here the same day.  Thank you .Dr. Sander and Tech Feliciana. You are awesome. I will definitely refer friends and family.

It took a while to post this, my Winnie had cancer, when it was her time to go  Valet Vets Dr Kim and Lauren came to our home, they were extremely caring in our worst moment, we all had a little cry as we put her to sleep, we put her on the gurney, got a goodbye hug from the doctors, 2.5 week later, Winnie was delivered back home, my dog was a SPCA dog, everytime we'd go to the vet, she would tremble, like I was going to return her, I would not allow that to be her last memory, the drive, the smells, the fear, no way, my baby went at home, surrounded by her family on her couch, your service and ladies are amazing,
Thank you Andy Klein

I’ve been a client for 3-4 years and love the service. The staff is quite friendly and professional. I love the fact that I don’t have to leave the house because my pet is quite timid around the vet so being in her own surroundings makes it a more pleasant experience for her.
Mia our cat enjoyed her visit from you both.  Larry & I are so thankful for your kindness & patience towards her 😻. …
I was very impressed with Dr Kim and Raeann. Their gentleness with my apprentice dog was amazing. Thank you!

I cannot say enough about how amazing the services are from Valet Vet. They provided comprehensive and compassionate care for our dog. When he was sick, their care was fantastic. When it came time for him to be euthanized, they provided the most sincere, compassionate care in our home. They have gone above and beyond what I could have imagined, even with follow-up emails and cards. They are such a blessing!!

We have been using Valet Vet to care for our dogs for over 3 years and couldn't be more impressed with the level of service they provide to our dogs. Their communication when scheduling appointments and post visits is excellent and have taken the time to answer every question and concern we had.  Every employee we have had the pleasure of interacting with has been so helpful. They are all so kind and friendly and have treated our dogs as if they were their own. If you have a dog that struggles with going to a brick and mortar Vet, this is the answer.

Was a great experience, less stress on my dog and
A Veterinarian who actually listened.

We have special rescue dogs who have extreme anxiety issues. I was worried about their needed vet visit because our favorite vet had left the practice. Dr. Channing came to our home and was wonderful! She took her time with our "special needs" dogs and calmed their fears. Some others have insisted on muzzling one of our dogs which only upsets her more. Dr. Channing didn't use a muzzle, she was just patient and calm. She did the exams, gave vaccines, and actually made friends with the dog who hates vets by the end of the visit. She also provided valuable advice for future vet visits.  Thank you Dr. Channing! You are our new favorite vet!

We have two amazing beagles, Leela and Fry. Fry is a chronic epileptic, and even mild stress—like being in a crowded space or around too many people or animals—can trigger cluster seizures. Because of this, taking him to a traditional vet isn't an option.

That's why Vet Valet has been a lifesaver for us. Their team is consistently professional, compassionate, and understanding. Fry is often stressed when they arrive, sometimes even trembling, but by the time the doctor and assistant leave, he's usually calm and comfortable.

We always sit on the floor together to help him feel safe, and I keep treats on hand for the vet to offer him when needed. Without services like Vet Valet, getting Fry the Keppra he needs each year would be a struggle—and honestly, he might not still be with us.
We’re incredibly grateful for what they do.
So professional and so easy for us and our senior cat, who absolutely hates going to the veterinarian.
Very friendly and helpful staff
They came out to my place. Great personalities. Great service did every Everything in a timely matter. But was not in a hurry. I would recommend them to anybody who needed a vet.

My baby who is 8 yrs old started having seizures and Dr. Jennifer was great they came out quick and seen my baby and made sure he was doing good. I am happy that I called them plus they check on him regularly just to keep update on how he is doing I really like them and I hope to keep them as my dog's vet for a long time
So glad I found Valet Vet!!  Was so nice to have our dog taken care of at home, and treated.

They write prescriptions and give him monthly injections of Librela for his injuries and age. He is in his environment, which makes him much more relaxed and willing to be examined, and the staff are always professional and able to do most exams from our home, including mobile xrays/ultrasounds, and weigh ins. We highly recommend using them. They will usually fit you in relatively quickly and book ahead for monthly injections. It's definitely worth the money to see our dog less stressed.

If you are in the devastating position of debating euthanasia for your sick pet, I can’t recommend Valet Vet enough. I was able to set up a last minute appointment for an at home euthanasia for my 9 year old cat who was experiencing kidney failure. He despised being in the veterinarian office and was super stressed from his rapidly worsening condition (not to mention all of the poking and prodding), but I was able to give him one last night at home before Dr. Channing and Dr. Vann arrived. They were so gentle and sweet to my boy during his last moments. They were so accommodating and encouraging, ensuring me that I was doing the right thing by him even though it felt like the most impossible decision. They walked me through everything that would and could happen and tried to prepare me as much as possible for the process. I even received a sweet note and inked paw print a week later (which of course reduced me to tears). Thank you so much for making such a terribly sad day just a little bit easier. 💛
